meta.description: Local verified data for Duncan's Guide – Townsville

beaches.name: The Strand Beach
beaches.notes: 2.2km beachfront promenade with swimming enclosures, water park, playgrounds, and BBQ facilities. Patrolled and stinger net protected.

beaches.name: Pallarenda Beach
beaches.notes: Quiet beach perfect for fishing, picnics, and walking. Great views of Magnetic Island. Dog-friendly area available.

beaches.name: Rowes Bay Beach
beaches.notes: Popular family spot with calm waters, shaded areas, and nearby playground. Close to dog park.

beaches.name: Shelly Beach
beaches.notes: Secluded cove with rock pools, ideal for snorkelling and exploring at low tide. Bring your own supplies.

beaches.name: Kissing Point
beaches.notes: Rocky outcrop with beach access, heritage fortifications, and stunning sunrise views. Popular for photography.

beaches.name: Cleveland Bay Beach
beaches.notes: Long stretch of beach perfect for morning walks and beach fishing. Less crowded than The Strand.

hairdressers.name: Just Cuts Castletown
hairdressers.notes: Walk-in only, open 9am–5:30pm Mon–Sat, 10am–4pm Sun. Affordable cuts for all ages.

hairdressers.name: Pure Hair
hairdressers.notes: Modern salon offering cuts and colour, online booking available. Specialises in balayage and styling.

hairdressers.name: Silver Strand Hair Studio
hairdressers.notes: Popular beachfront salon with friendly staff and sea views. Great for a pampering session.

hairdressers.name: Toni&Guy Townsville
hairdressers.notes: Upscale salon with expert stylists. Book ahead for colour and special occasion styling.

hairdressers.name: The Barber Shop Townsville
hairdressers.notes: Traditional barber offering hot towel shaves, beard trims, and modern cuts. Walk-ins welcome.

restaurants.name: JAM Restaurant
restaurants.notes: Award-winning dining with local produce and fine wines. Book ahead for weekend dinners.

restaurants.name: Cactus Jack's
restaurants.notes: Casual dining, margaritas, and a lively atmosphere. Great for groups and families.

restaurants.name: Longboard Bar & Grill
restaurants.notes: Perfect for sunset drinks and burgers by the sea. Live music on weekends.

restaurants.name: Juliette's Gelateria
restaurants.notes: Iconic gelato café, pet-friendly outdoor seating, great for coffee and treats. Try the mango sorbet.

restaurants.name: A Touch of Salt
restaurants.notes: Waterfront fine dining with fresh seafood and premium steaks. Romantic setting with marina views.

restaurants.name: The Ville Resort-Casino Restaurants
restaurants.address: Sir Leslie Thiess Drive, Townsville City
restaurants.notes: Multiple dining options including Asian fusion, Italian, and buffet. Casino and entertainment onsite.

dog_parks.name: Rowes Bay Dog Park
dog_parks.notes: Large open area, shaded, near the beach. Popular with locals. Water fountain and bins available.

dog_parks.name: Murray Sporting Complex Dog Park
dog_parks.notes: Fenced area with agility equipment. Separate zones for small and large dogs.

dog_parks.name: The Strand Foreshore
dog_parks.notes: Scenic coastal walk, pet-friendly areas and water access. Dogs must be on-leash in most areas.

dog_parks.name: Pallarenda Dog Beach
dog_parks.notes: Off-leash dog beach area. Great for swimming and socialising. Check signage for designated zones.

dog_parks.name: Queens Gardens Dog Area
dog_parks.notes: Small designated dog area in historic gardens. On-leash only. Shaded and close to cafes.

dog_parks.name: Bicentennial Park Dog Park
dog_parks.notes: Quiet suburban park with off-leash hours. Good for training and exercise.

accommodation.name: The Ville Resort-Casino
accommodation.address: Sir Leslie Thiess Drive, Townsville City
accommodation.notes: Luxury resort with pools, casino, restaurants, and bars. Close to city attractions.

accommodation.name: Rydges Southbank Townsville
accommodation.notes: Modern hotel with rooftop pool and gym. Walking distance to restaurants and Strand.

accommodation.name: Quest Townsville
accommodation.notes: Apartment-style accommodation with kitchens. Ideal for longer stays and families.

accommodation.name: Mariners North Holiday Apartments
accommodation.notes: Waterfront apartments with pools and BBQ areas. Close to marina and restaurants.

accommodation.name: Peppers Blue on Blue Resort
accommodation.notes: Luxury resort on Magnetic Island. Ferry transfers available. Perfect for a weekend escape.

accommodation.name: Townsville Holiday Park
accommodation.notes: Family-friendly park with cabins, powered sites, and camp kitchen. Pool and playground onsite.

things_to_do.name: Castle Hill Lookout
things_to_do.notes: Townsville's iconic pink granite monolith. Drive or walk to the summit for 360° views. Best at sunset.

things_to_do.name: Magnetic Island
things_to_do.notes: Beaches, hiking trails, koalas, and snorkelling. Hire a buggy or scooter to explore. Don't miss Horseshoe Bay.

things_to_do.name: Jezzine Barracks
things_to_do.notes: Coastal walkway with military history displays, public art, and cafes. Free entry. Great for photography.

things_to_do.name: Billabong Sanctuary
things_to_do.notes: Hands-on wildlife experience. Hold a koala, feed kangaroos, watch croc feeding shows. Family-friendly.

things_to_do.name: Reef HQ Great Barrier Reef Aquarium
things_to_do.notes: World's largest living coral reef aquarium. Turtle hospital, shark dive, and coral display. Educational and fun.

things_to_do.name: Museum of Tropical Queensland
things_to_do.notes: Explore HMS Pandora shipwreck, natural history, and regional culture. Great for kids and history buffs.

shopping.name: Castletown Shopping Centre
shopping.notes: Major retail centre with Coles, Woolworths, Target, and specialty stores. Good food court and cinema.

shopping.name: Stockland Townsville
shopping.notes: Largest shopping centre in North Queensland. Fashion, electronics, cinemas, and dining. Event Cinemas onsite.

shopping.name: Cotters Market
shopping.notes: Weekly Sunday market (8am–1pm) with fresh produce, crafts, food stalls, and live music. Local favourite.

shopping.name: Flinders Street Mall
shopping.notes: Pedestrian mall with boutiques, cafes, and street entertainment. Shaded and close to waterfront.

shopping.name: Willows Shopping Centre
shopping.notes: Regional centre with Big W, supermarkets, and fashion stores. Good parking and family facilities.

shopping.name: Riverway Shopping Centre
shopping.notes: Convenient local shops with Woolworths, specialty stores, and medical services. Near Riverway precinct.

emergency.vet: Townsville Veterinary Clinic, 34 Bowen Road, Hermit Park

transport.bus: Sunbus Townsville – main routes connect the Strand, City, and Stockland
transport.ferry: Magnetic Island Ferry – departs from Breakwater Terminal every 20–30 mins
